    Fischbacher §5.3–5.4: replacing the end of a good walk #

    ZWalk.Good.replace: in a good walk with a segment σ of valley c, replace σ and all later segments by a new linked list M from the left peak of σ (with a new final path along w). If the new pieces are nontrivial with nonzero s-values, consecutive peaks of M are incomparable, M is separating (also at its junction with the kept part) in every convex subset of the old hull avoiding c, and no new vertex lies below c, then the new walk is good, has the same first peak and a strictly smaller hull (by the key fact (K), c leaves the hull).

    Prop

    The peak between two consecutive segments is separating in H.
